baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full construction خلق الجان من مارج من نار, especially the two من phrases.
baseline_models.mechanism: Originating brings a concealed spirit-kind from fire in its flaring, released, disordered, and locally unstable mode. The act produces a determinate kind without erasing the source's kinetic instability.

activation_trace.role: Originating and bringing into being supplies the productive act that makes a kind from a source.
The hidden-spirit branch identifies the created subject while retaining concealment.
Flaring flame makes مارج the active flame-mode of the fire source.
Released grazing contributes outward, unherded motion as a secondary kinetic register.
Confused disorder contributes internal turbulence rather than a static element.
Looseness within a place makes instability constitutive yet locally held.
Burning, flickering fire supplies the encompassing material field from which the مارج mode is selected.

changed_reading.before: A species is simply said to have been made from smokeless fire.
changed_reading.after: A determinate hidden kind is originated from fire precisely in its flaring, released, and unstable behavior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of الجان, rooted in concealment, with نار, whose inventory foregrounds illumination and visibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject is hidden from perception while its source announces itself as light, a fire sighted from afar, and a beacon. Concealed agency is therefore generated from an exposing medium rather than from darkness alone.

activation_trace.role: Covering from perception supplies the subject's constitutive hiddenness.
The hidden-spirit branch keeps the paradox attached to الجان rather than to concealment in general.
Illumination makes the source perceptually disclosing.
Fire sighted from afar gives the source long-range detectability.
The visible beacon branch turns fire into an orienting sign as well as heat.

changed_reading.before: Fire names only the jann's unseen substance.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a visibility paradox: an unseen agent is made from a medium whose light exposes and orients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خلق set against the interlacing and unsteadiness latent in مارج and نار.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measuring and complete formation stand against tangling, flight, and lack of steadiness. Creation can therefore be heard as bounding a moving field into form, not as quenching its movement.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the act of bounding the source.
Complete, balanced form supplies the determinate result.
Interlaced branches and a crooked arrow contribute entangled directional motion.
Flight and lack of steadiness add a form-distant but live recoil register to the fire source.

changed_reading.before: Creation fixes a preexisting fiery substance into a creature.
changed_reading.after: Creation proportionally contains interlaced motion, yielding stable identity without making the source motionless.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial reckoning and the repeated scale vocabulary strengthen خلق as measuring: مارج is calibrated turbulence inside an ordered cosmos, not a pocket of chaos exempt from measure.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning turns creation into calibration.
Confused disorder names the turbulence that requires calibration.
Counting and calculation supply a cosmic regime of exact recurrence.
A created thing made in balance directly links weighing to constituted form.
The straight scale contributes rectitude and bounded proportion to the mechanism.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 places calculation, the established scale, and commanded just weighing before the paired origin verses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, weighing, a straight scale, and خلق's measuring branch; I infer that the instability of مارج is itself apportioned. A live alternative is that the scale unit governs ethics and cosmos without specifying creaturely composition.

changed_reading.before: مارج is exceptional disorder opposed to cosmic order.
changed_reading.after: Its turbulence is a measured mode within the same order, so volatility and proportion coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent human-origin line turns 55:15 into the second half of a material diptych: dry resonant clay becomes fired ceramic, while loose, interlaced flame becomes a hidden moving kind. Both are formed, but one source holds shape and echoes while the other propagates and shifts.

activation_trace.role: Looseness in place supplies the jann source's mobile material regime.
Tangling and crooked motion make that regime internally interlaced.
Repeated originating makes the two adjacent subjects parallel products of one creative act.
Human appearance in opposition to wildness and jinn sharpens the paired subject contrast.
Dry clay that resounds supplies a rigid, hollow, acoustically revealing material state.
Fired ceramic supplies retained shape and a processed solid counterpart to moving flame.

structural_cues: 55:14 and 55:15 repeat خلق, subject, and source clauses in immediate sequence, but change the source simile and material behavior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic pairing, resonant dry clay, ceramic, and unstable flame; I infer a contrast between material behaviors rather than merely two ingredient labels. The alternative is a taxonomic list with no transfer from the clay simile to the fire line.

changed_reading.before: 55:15 independently reports a second species and its ingredient.
changed_reading.after: It completes a paired experiment in creaturely form: resonant solidity and interlaced mobility are two deliberately fashioned regimes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later release of two expansive waters so that they meet, while a between-space prevents transgression, projects a flow geometry back onto مارج. The focus source becomes mobile strands capable of contact and interpenetration yet held in a coherent limit, not homogeneous flame or unbounded confusion.

activation_trace.role: Flaring flame keeps the focus source materially fiery.
Disorder supplies the risk of losing distinction when motions meet.
Tangling supplies contact without requiring complete fusion.
Released grazing gives the later verb a spatial image of letting flows range.
Abundant wide water supplies two expansive moving fields.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies interface and contact.
The middle between two things supplies a maintained interface rather than simple separation.
Not crossing a limit constrains released motion without cancelling it.

structural_cues: 55:19 repeats M-R-J, then dual meeting, an explicit barzakh, and dual non-transgression form a release-contact-limit sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, wide waters, meeting, a between-space, and non-transgression; I project that flow geometry back onto the focus noun. The live alternative is that verbal sea-release and nominal flame belong to separate senses whose shared root should not control the source's physics.

changed_reading.before: مارج means an undifferentiated mixture or chaotic flame.
changed_reading.after: It can denote bounded interpenetrating motion: released fiery strands meet and tangle while retaining a created limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between the encompassing all that passes away and the one who remains prevents fiery origin from implying elemental immortality. Created flame-life is contingent precisely because it is brought into being.

activation_trace.role: Being originated anchors the jann on the created side of the later contrast.
Encompassing totality expands the perishing claim beyond an isolated object.
Cessation and disappearance after duration supplies creaturely finitude.
Enduring continuance belongs to the contrasting remainder, not to the fiery source.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 sets an exhaustive perishing clause against a singular remaining clause shortly after the two creation accounts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies createdness and the perish/remain opposition; I include the jann among contingent creatures. A material alternative remains because the immediate phrase 'upon it' may narrow the perishing set to earthbound referents.

changed_reading.before: Origin in fire may suggest a deathless elemental being.
changed_reading.after: Fire is a contingent created source; its intensity grants no share in the unique remaining that follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two weighty collectives are addressed as jinn and humans and challenged to pass through the sides of the heavens and earth only with authority. Released and locally loose motion in مارج becomes a possible affordance for traversal, but created mobility remains jurisdictionally bounded.

activation_trace.role: Released ranging supplies the kinetic tendency projected into attempted traversal.
Looseness within a place supplies mobility that still presupposes a containing domain.
Weight opposed to lightness recasts the two kinds as consequential collectives, not disembodied elements.
The hidden-spirit branch explicitly reconnects the later addressed collective to the focus subject.
Visible humanity supplies the paired collective alongside the concealed jinn.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted kinetic action.
Sides and extremities supply the boundary surface to be crossed.
Power and jurisdiction make authorized capacity, not fiery nature, the condition of passage.

structural_cues: 55:31 names a dual collective, and 55:33 expands it as jinn and humans under repeated penetration verbs and an authority condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mobile focus source, paired collectives, attempted penetration, domain edges, and authority; I infer that source-motion foreshadows an affordance rather than a guaranteed power. The alternative is that the challenge is purely juridical and says nothing about jannic constitution.

changed_reading.before: The fiery source is only retrospective origin information.
changed_reading.after: Its released motion can foreshadow kinetic agency, while the later authority clause denies that constitution itself grants sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire later returns as a dispatched flame against both addressees, accompanied by a live copper-or-smoke material fork and failed defense. The same elemental domain can constitute the jann and oppose it; origin is affinity without immunity.

activation_trace.role: The focus's flaring flame establishes the subject's fiery source-mode.
Burning fire anchors the elemental identity that will be reversed.
Dispatch and outward sending turn fire into an imposed counterforce.
Flame without smoke closely echoes the focus's flaring fire while changing its direction.
The repeated burning-fire branch makes the origin and counterforce share an explicit elemental field.
Red metal keeps a molten metallic companion to the flame live.
Smoke without flame preserves a coexisting nonmetal reading of the companion force.
The denied ability to aid or prevail makes same-domain vulnerability explicit.

structural_cues: 55:35 repeats من نار after the penetration challenge and addresses the same dual audience that includes the jinn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated fire phrase, dispatched smokeless flame, copper-or-smoke branches, and failed defense; I infer a constitution-to-counterforce reversal. The alternative is that shared fire vocabulary marks sensory similarity without implying special relevance to the jann's origin.

changed_reading.before: Being made from fire implies elemental affinity or resistance.
changed_reading.after: Affinity is reversible: fire can be source and enforcing counterforce, so fiery constitution confers no immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's splitting and becoming rose-like oil supplies a nearby grammar of phase change, red luminosity, and glossy flow. It back-activates مارج من نار as a process-state of fire rather than a fixed ingredient, with smoke-pigment as a secondary visual texture.

activation_trace.role: Disordered mixing supplies a turbulent phase rather than a stable substance.
Interlacing supplies filamentary structure inside the phase.
Smoke pigment supplies a deposited visual trace at the edge of the fire inventory.
Splitting open supplies the rupture that permits a state transition.
Occurrence in time makes 'becoming' an eventful change of state.
Rose and red-infused color supply the transformed phase's chromatic field.
Oil and coating supply glossy liquidity and surface behavior.

structural_cues: 55:37 uses rupture, becoming, color, and an oil simile in one compact transformation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit cosmic state change and focus branches of disorder, interlacing, and pigment; I infer an analogical process model for مارج. The alternative is that the eschatological sky image has no constitutive bearing on the earlier origin statement.

changed_reading.before: The preposition من names fire as a static raw substance.
changed_reading.after: It can also name a fire-phase: turbulent, filamentary, luminous matter in active transformation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concealed subject and fire's branding or pigment potential meet the later sequence of recognition by visible marks and seizure. Hiddenness is a perceptual condition that can be reversed by inscription; it is not guaranteed untraceability.

activation_trace.role: Covering from perception establishes the hidden condition to be reversed.
Branding by burning fire gives the source a latent mark-making capacity.
Smoke pigment extends fire's mark-making register from brand to inscription-like trace.
Recognition and distinction by an effect or sign supplies the epistemic reversal.
A visible identifying mark supplies the trace by which the concealed becomes legible.
Seizure and capture make recognition operational rather than merely visual.

structural_cues: 55:39 names both human and jann before 55:41 replaces questioning with recognition by marks and immediate seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus concealment, fire branches of branding and pigment, then recognition by marks and capture; I infer traceability as a latent reversal of hiddenness. The alternative is that the later juridical signs are imposed independently of fiery origin.

changed_reading.before: الجَان names an intrinsically untraceable hidden being.
changed_reading.after: Its concealment can coexist with a fire-derived capacity to bear revealing traces; hiddenness is revocable, not absolute.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the marjan branch of M-R-J inside مارج and shifts from continuous flame to jewel-like particles. It remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by the same root at 55:22 and 55:58 beside pearl and ruby imagery. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary texture activated by the root inventory, not as an equation of مارج with coral or pearls.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مارج at word 4, through the root's marjan branch while the literal fire construction remains active.

activation_trace.role: Pearls or red beads supply a granular, scintillating secondary texture to the focus flame.
The explicit marjan occurrence realizes the same branch as an object emerging from the two waters.
Marjan in a ruby comparison intensifies the branch's red jewel register.
Pearl-like gleaming supplies the optical behavior for the beaded-fire rendering.

changed_reading.before: مارج is pictured only as one continuous tongue or sheet of flame.
changed_reading.after: A contained side-reading pictures scintillating red or pearl-like nodes moving within the flaring field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surfaces conventionally point to hidden spirit and fire, while the activated branches point to garden cover, pasture, and blossom. It remains packet-anchored in all three focus roots and is strengthened by later gardens, branching boughs, and flowing water. Downstream prose should retain it as a dormant ecological counter-register, never as a replacement for the fiery spirit reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch cluster الجان, مارج, and نار at words 2, 4, and 6.

activation_trace.role: Tree-covered garden turns concealment into dense living cover.
Meadow and released grazing supply open growth and ranging movement.
Tree blossom supplies a generative edge inside the fire root's inventory.
The later dual gardens realize concealed tree-cover in the surah's own imagery.
Branching boughs give the hidden cover articulated, proliferating structure.
Flowing and spreading movement supplies the ecology's mobile circulation.

changed_reading.before: The origin image is sterile combustion with no generative register.
changed_reading.after: A contained lexical counter-reading hears concealed cover, released growth, blossom, and flow dormant inside the fiery formulation.

strongest_changes: The unstable مارج source became calibrated turbulence rather than chaos outside measure.
The adjacent clay verse turned 55:15 into a contrast between resonant solidity and interlaced mobility.
The sea reuse of M-R-J supplied release, meeting, interface, and non-transgression as a bounded-flow model.
The repeated fire of 55:35 reversed source into counterforce, preserving affinity while removing immunity.
Later recognition by marks made concealment revocable and trace-bearing rather than absolute.
summary.what_was_special: Same-root recurrences did more than confirm dictionary senses: they reversed direction, supplied flow geometry, and exposed latent material behaviors. Branch-distant beaded and ecological readings remain live beside, not instead of, the strong fiery-creation models.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from released seas to the physics of مارج is analogical; the verbal and nominal senses may remain separate.
The calculation and scale sequence may govern cosmos and ethics without directly specifying creaturely constitution.
The scope of 'all upon it' leaves the jann's inclusion in the perishing contrast inferential.
The phase, marking, marjan, and growth activations are visibly anchored but branch-distant and should remain qualified rather than synthesized into one reading.
